title: Agent assets lint: check your AI instruction files against your own rules
summary: A small Node tool that checks CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills and agent files against rules you write in one JSON file: line budgets, required headings, matching skill names, real descriptions. Comes with a starter policy for a plain Claude Code project.
why: I ran it across 81 of my own Claude Code projects. It found 30 agent files with no header at all, 28 of them in 7 projects I had copied from an older setup of mine.

card.headline: Keep your AI's instruction files in shape
card.what: A small custom Node tool that checks your AI's instruction files against your own rules.
card.note: Is my CLAUDE.md getting too long?
card.reply: Yes: 240 lines against your 200 limit, and one skill has no description.
card.foot: a Node tool for any coding agent
